worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.summary: Eats its held Berry whole and sharply boosts its Defense; the Berry's own effect (healing, status cure or a stat boost) also lands on the user. Cannot be used with no Berry held. Savoring draws more healing from the Berry and boosts Defense further, at the cost of chewing longer and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.use.0: Trade a held Berry for a layer of Defense before a fight
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.use.1: Save yourself with the Berry's healing or status cure
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.use.2: Eat a stat Berry such as a Liechi whole, effect included
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.descriptio: Swallowing this raises the user's Defense by %1$s stage(s); a heavier body braces harder.
The Berry's healing is absorbed at %1$s times, while its status cure and stat boost still apply as they are; it then takes %2$s of chewing to finish. It cannot be used with no Berry held.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.stance.sav: Savor: x1.35 Berry healing and +1 Defense, at the cost of +2 ticks of wind-up, longer chewing and a longer cooldown - for a good Berry and some spare time.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.stance.gul: Gulp: fast and cheap with a shorter cooldown, but x0.85 Berry healing and only the base Defense - for bracing right before a hit.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.timing: Cast on yourself: %1$s s of wind-up, spending %3$s PP, then %2$s s of recovery and a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stuffcheeks.preference: On: x1.35 Berry healing and +1 Defense, with +2 ticks of wind-up, longer chewing and a longer cooldown. Off: faster and cheaper, but x0.85 Berry healing and only the base Defense.
The Berry is eaten only when a threat is within this distance; lower eats only up close, higher braces earlier from afar.
world_combat.move.stuffcheeks.text.none: No Berry held - nothing to eat
